description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class for testing the LDAPSetting DTO class in the LDAP plugin of the OrangeHRM project. It includes test methods to verify the string serialization of LDAP settings and exception handling for invalid input.

classes.name: LDAPSettingTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for LDAPSetting DTO, testing serialization and validation.

methods.name: testFromString
methods.description: Tests creation of LDAPSetting object, checks JSON serialization, and verifies that invalid input raises an exception.
